hsm.title: Highway Safety Manual
hsm.decided: critical rate against the corridor's own sites (user, #34 item 7, docs/03); used in every state until that state's own screening is built

crash_costs.missing: DelDOT publishes no crash costs: its 2025 HSIP report says it 'began development of Delaware-specific crash costs using FHWA values as a guide' and plans to complete them in 2026 (page not recorded: FHWA refused the PDF download)

statewide_rates.missing: DelDOT publishes no statewide average crash-rate table, and CrashIQ has no Delaware traffic counts

screening.state_method: DelDOT Hazard Elimination Program: 3-year crash history; segments ranked by crash rate on a 0.1-mile sliding window, signalized and unsignalized intersections by crash frequency and severity (DelDOT HSIP presentation, 2024, PDF p. 9)

min_years.page: PDF p. 9 (HEP: 'Identification of sites is based on 3-year crash history')
min_years.note: DelDOT's network-screening window, not a stated minimum for a corridor study: the user decides

spf_calibration.missing: DelDOT is still developing Delaware calibration factors for the HSM (2025 HSIP report); none published
